claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mafenide is a sulfonamide carbonic anhydrase inhibitor with weak, non-selective antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM for 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cancer-cell killing, since its annotated targets (CA2/4/6/9/12/14) are not required for proliferation and no cytotoxic off-target is evident at this low concentration.
